googleAds.title: Our Google Ads integration.
googleAds.intro: Studio Galilei uses the official Google Ads API to manage partners' campaigns. Directly on their accounts, securely and with explicit consent.

steps.title: We build
steps.desc: We create, edit and structure campaigns, ad groups and keywords.

steps.title: We measure
steps.desc: We monitor impressions, clicks, costs and conversions in real time.

steps.title: We optimise
steps.desc: We adjust bids and budgets based on observed results, not promises.

steps.title: We report
steps.desc: We produce clear, regular reports that anyone can read, even outside the industry.

trust.title: Explicit consent
trust.desc: Access to the partner's Google Ads account happens only through Google OAuth, after explicit authorisation by the account owner. No shortcuts, no shared passwords.

trust.title: Partner control
trust.desc: The partner keeps full control and can revoke the authorisation at any time from their Google Account settings.

trust.title: Google API · Limited Use
trust.desc: We use the data we access only to provide and improve the campaign management services requested by the partner, in compliance with the <policy>Google API Services User Data Policy</policy>, including the Limited Use requirements.

googleAds.note: To learn in detail how we process, store and protect data, read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
